scope: Independent18pose review for Siamese Cat v002, Fairy Pitta v001 and Onagadori v001

review.identity: All six poses preserve the adopted seal-point Siamese identity, blue oval eyes, whiskers, rounded face/body proportions and watercolor-paper fill. The unrequested yellow aha accents are removed in v002.
review.style: Canonical-plus-six-pose renders at430px body height on cream and dark teal look natural, with moderate family-brown contours and no sticker-like outlier.
review.alpha: Actual RGBA0..254: effectively opaque subject with genuinely transparent surroundings. All cell-edge maxima<=1. Correct alpha composites show no visible brown background, halo or clipping.
review.motion: One standing reference413px and manually reviewed actual-toe anchors are fixed for all six poses. Neutral entry/exit keyframes retain head/body size and foot baseline. Key-pose playback is discrete, not interpolated final animation.

review.style: Canonical280px comparison on cream/dark preserves the warm-brown moderate contour, dot-eye convention and watercolor-paper family design.
review.alpha: RGBA alpha0..254, subject clear, cell edge alpha maxima0..1, no visible matte/halo or boundary clipping.
review.identity: Six poses preserve pitta color regions, compact body, one beak/tail and two legs/wings; no duplicated or cut anatomy.
review.motion: One common upright reference408px for all six frames, with actual toe anchors aligned at280px body display. Canonical entry/exit keeps size and baseline natural. The deeper dip remains about25..28screen pixels above the toe baseline and is described as a downward pecking/dipping gesture, not beak-ground contact. Discrete keyposes only; episode timing/interpolation is not yet certified.

review.identity: All six poses preserve the white-variety rooster, red single comb/wattles, pale legs and multiple separate flowing white tail feathers. No missing or duplicated body parts; entire long tail remains visible.
review.style: Canonical-plus-six-pose renders at280px anatomical body height preserve the family watercolor-paper texture and warm-brown contour. Fine interior feather lines remain distinct from the exterior silhouette.
review.alpha: RGBA0..255 with cell-edge maxima<=1. Correct cream/dark composites show no visible fringe, matte, hidden-RGB discoloration or cut parts. Minimum visible cell margin13px in the forward dip remains clear.
review.motion: One upright-body reference309px for every pose, separate manual body/tail bounds and actual-toe anchors. Neutral and wing frames align naturally. Downward dip is a near-ground pecking gesture; beak appears about5..10px above the support baseline at280px, so exact beak-ground contact is not certified. Full tail remains reserved independently of body scale.

motion_review_method: Native originals and canonical-registered cream/dark composites were viewed. Discrete GIF previews were decoded, timed and checked for neutral entry/exit, with first/last frames exact. This does not certify interpolation or final episode timing.
